claims.evidence: Witness photos show an Xbox console with an Xbox logo and a controller, but do not show the exact console model (Series S vs Series X vs One) or storage size, nor any visible list of installed games.
Monitor close-up shows “EA SPORTS FC 25”, not FC 26.
No photo shows the Far Cry 3 game library/menu or a running Far Cry 3 screen.
No photo shows Modern Warfare 3 in the game library/menu or a running MW3 screen.
No photo shows Dishonored 2 in the game library/menu or a running Dishonored 2 screen.
No photo shows the full title (e.g., Tomb Raider) or a game library screen confirming it.

risks.risk: Console model and storage are unknown (Series S vs Series X vs One), which strongly affects value and compatibility/performance.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model label/serial sticker (back/bottom) showing exact model and storage, plus the console settings → System → About screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case/lowest-spec Xbox model with no confirmed storage, treating it as a basic used console.

risks.risk: Working status is not confirmed (HDMI output, disc drive status if applicable, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the console booting to dashboard, HDMI display working, and (if applicable) a quick test of Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth connection in settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults (e.g., HDMI/Wi‑Fi issues), assuming buyer may need repairs.

risks.risk: Controller condition is unknown (stick drift, button responsiveness, battery/charging).
risks.proof: A clip showing controller connected and responding in a game/menu (moving sticks, pressing buttons) plus a battery/charging indicator screen if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller may need replacement or repair (worst-case: drift or weak battery).

risks.risk: Monitor specifications and health are unknown (size, resolution/refresh rate, dead pixels, brightness issues).
risks.proof: Photos of the monitor model label (back) and a screen test image/video showing dead pixels/brightness uniformity; also show monitor settings page for resolution/refresh rate.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case monitor condition/specs (unknown resolution/possible pixel issues).

risks.risk: Included accessories are unknown (HDMI cable, power cable, headset, original box). Missing cables reduce usability and value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included item with cables clearly visible (power brick/cable, HDMI, controller charging method).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing at least some accessories/cables.

risks.risk: Game claims may be inaccurate (seller says FC 26 but screen shows FC 25; other titles not shown).
risks.proof: A photo/video of the Xbox “My games & apps” library showing the installed titles list (including the exact EA FC version).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the currently visible game is confirmed and the rest are not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Account status is unknown (logged-in accounts, bans, not factory reset), which can cause access issues.
risks.proof: A clip showing the console reset/factory reset process or confirmation that it’s signed out and ready for setup (settings → system → reset).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher risk for account/access problems.

proof_requests: Exact Xbox console model and storage: clear photo of the model label/serial sticker and the System → About screen.
Working proof: short video of boot to dashboard and a quick settings check for HDMI output and Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth.
Controller health: clip showing controller inputs working (sticks/buttons) and battery/charging status.
Monitor specs and condition: photo of monitor model label plus a dead-pixel/brightness test screen.
Confirm included accessories: laid-out photo of all cables and items (power, HDMI, controller charging method).
Confirm installed games: photo/video of “My games & apps” showing the installed titles list (including the exact EA FC version).
Account/reset status: clip showing signed-out state and/or factory reset confirmation.
response.reason: The witness confirms a Dell monitor, an Xbox console, and an Xbox-style controller, but key value drivers (exact console model/storage, working status, controller condition, monitor specs, and installed games list) are not verifiable from the provided shots. Without those, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
